plain: Training an already-trained model a bit more on new examples to change what it does.
eli5: Teaching a dog that already knows "sit" a new trick with a few more lessons.
technical: Continuing to train a pretrained model's weights on a smaller, targeted dataset (supervised examples, preferences or rewards); with open weights anyone can fine-tune away safety training, which is why worst-case fine-tuning is part of release risk assessment.
